item.title: Trivia Tuesday: Ramsey County
item.description: Producer Betsy Melin puts the hosts to the test on their knowledge of Ramsey County.

item.title: Spring Adventures Across Minnesota
item.description: From scenic trails to cozy indoor escapes, Explore Minnesota’s Jake Juliot shares fresh ideas to help you make the most of the new season. Whether you're ready to get outside after the spring equinox or prefer to ease in indoors, there’s something for everyone across the state.

item.title: Declutter Your Home This Spring
item.description: Spring cleaning is in full swing, and Cori McDougald of Meat &amp; Potatoes Organizing is sharing practical ways to simplify your space. From smart storage solutions to easy decluttering tips, she’s helping you refresh your home for the new season.

item.title: The Art of Glass Blowing
item.description: Glass blowing is an extraordinary art form that’s capturing hearts on the Netflix show Blown Away. This mesmerizing reality series comes to life through the skilled hands of local glass blower Dante Germain. Kelli Hanson takes us on a vivid journey to Dante’s Minneapolis studio where his stunning creations are crafted.

item.title: Game time set for Gophers-Bruins Sweet 16 matchup
item.description: Coming off a dramatic last-second game-winner over Ole Miss, the Minnesota Gophers women's basketball team will now head west to face UCLA in the Sweet 16.

item.title: Will the NFL Draft come to Minnesota? State is aiming for 2028
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of fans attend the NFL Draft each year. Minnesota is trying to bring the event here soon.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie in NBC News interview appeals for help finding her missing mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie says in a tearful interview on NBC that "'somebody needs to do the right thing” and provide information that leads to a resolution of the case of her missing 84-year-old mother. Guthrie says she wakes up every night wondering about the terror that her mother went through. The “Today” show aired a portion of Hoda Kotb’s interview with her colleague Wednesday and says it will air more on Thursday and Friday — the first interview Guthrie has given since her mother went missing near

item.title: Preservation work at Split Rock Lighthouse expected to be finished by July
item.description: Work began this month on a project aimed at protecting and preserving one of Minnesota's most visited attractions.

item.title: Walz to tout infrastructure plan as lawmakers consider state spending bills
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz is set to tout his $900 million infrastructure plan as he starts his statewide tour, making his case for funding for improvement projects across Minnesota.

item.title: City of St. Paul settles with family of teen who was shot by rec center employee for $9.5M
item.description: The city of St. Paul has agreed to pay $9.5 million to the family of a boy who was shot and injured by a rec center employee.

item.title: A Love of Water Towers
item.description: Kirk and Connie Brown, along with their kids, created the website, Minnesota Water Towers to document hundreds of towers across the state.

item.title: Climbing the Edina Water Tower
item.description: About three years ago, Megan Newquist and fellow Edina resident Ben Leber climbed 210 feet to the top of the tower for an unforgettable view of the community.

item.title: Osseo Water Tower Mascot
item.description: The beloved Osseo Water Tower was built in 1915 and earned its spot on the National Register of Historic Places

item.title: Recipes Using Pears
item.description: Macey Brickweg from Coborn's shares kid-friendly recipes featuring pears, with help from programming director Mandy Tadych's daughter Stella.

item.title: Using Water Tower Wednesday to Learn
item.description: oung students at Minnewashta Elementary School reached out because they love water towers as much as we do, and our series Water Tower Wednesday actually impacted their curriculum.
